description: This is a test class for the EmpUsTaxExemptionDao PHP class, which manages US tax exemption data for employees. It contains setup and multiple test methods to validate get, save, and edit functionalities of the DAO class, using the PHPUnit framework.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the functionality of the EmpUsTaxExemptionDao, focusing on retrieving and updating employee tax exemption data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO instance and loads test fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Tests retrieving an employee tax exemption record for employee ID 1 and asserts its fields.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new employee tax exemption record, then validating its properties.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Tests editing an existing employee tax exemption record and validating the updates.
